survival.frontierhunts.journal.heat.chil: Chilly. A tent, a cabin or a fire stops the slide; furs keep it away.
survival.frontierhunts.journal.heat.shiv: Shivering: your aim shakes and you move slower. Get into a tent or a cabin and light a fire: shelter and fire together warm you even in a blizzard.
survival.frontierhunts.journal.heat.hypo: Hypothermia: slow and clumsy, healing halved. Get out of the storm into a tent, a cabin or a cave and find a fire.
survival.frontierhunts.journal.heat.free: You are freezing and losing health. Get into shelter and by a fire now.
survival.frontierhunts.journal.heat.comf: Comfortable. Wet clothes, wind and nightfall cut your warmth; a tent, a roof and a fire give it back.
survival.frontierhunts.msg.shiver: You are shivering. Get into a tent or a cabin, or sit by a fire.
survival.frontierhunts.msg.freezing: You are freezing! Get into shelter and by a fire now.
survival.frontierhunts.msg.cold_night: You slept cold and woke up chilled to the bone. A tent, a roof, a fire or a hide bedroll would have helped.
guide.frontierhunts.tip.cold.body: Get out of the wind: a tent, a cabin or a cave keeps the storm off and holds your warmth, and a fire inside warms you fastest. Tan hides and furs into coats, hats and mukluks; a fur lining fits under your camo.
